question.text: At LEAST one key personnel of the Manager of a Cat III AIF must:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 5.2.2, at least one key person must obtain NISM-Series XIX-C or XIX-E certification and renew as needed. The Trap: CFA/PhD/specific experience are optional. Cross-Exam Context: Cross-reference to XIX-C and XIX-E. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Track certification expiry for key personnel and renew ahead of deadlines.
